name: Control shrines
description:
The mod introduces three new Shrine objects that allow to obtain Town Portal, Fly or Dimension Door.

Shrine of Sylvan Wisdom

Value: 12000
Rarity: 20
Zone limit: 1
Map limit: 4

Allows the hero to learn Town Portal spell for 3 turns in exchange for 1000 gold and 2 of each rare resource. Can be visited once per week.

Shrine of Aeolian Wisdom

Value: 12000
Rarity: 20
Zone limit: 1
Map limit: 4

Allows the hero to learn Fly spell for 3 turns in exchange for 2000 gold and 4 of each rare resource. Can be visited once per week.

Divine Shrine

Value: 16000
Rarity: 20
Zone limit: 1
Map limit: 2

Allows the hero to learn Dimension Door. Requires at least 15. level or knowledge of two magic schools at expert level. Can be visited only once.
author: wnukos, Andruids
